feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 24 November 2026 5:00am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds. Gales for a time.


##Wind)##

Southeast 6 or 7, quickly increasing 7 or gale 8 this morning. West and southern areas becoming cyclonic 3 to 5 early afternoon whilst remaining southeast 6 or 7 elsewhere, which will then decrease 5 or 6 later. Becoming east or southeast 5 or 6 in most waters overnight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather)##

Outbreaks of rain becoming widespread and persistent for much of the day and sometimes heavy.


##Visibility)##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in rain area.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 8°C and max. air temperature 10°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

Southeast 5 or 6, soon decreasing 4 or 5, backing east or southeast 3 to 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather)##

Patchy rain at first, quickly becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 8°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Thursday, 26 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds soon developing, gales later.


##Wind)##

East or southeast 4 or 5, soon increasing southeast 5 or 6, then 6 or 7, occasionally gale 8 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then risk of rain later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in any rain later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 7°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Friday, 27 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Gales at first, then strong winds.


##Wind)##

Southeast 6 or 7, occasionally gale 8 at first, soon veering west or northwest 2 to 4 for a time, then settling south or southeast later.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough becoming slight.


##Weather)##

Rain at first soon becoming mainly fair.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain at first.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 8°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Saturday, 28 November 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds later.


##Wind)##

South or southeast 2 to 4, veering southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, then veering west or southwest later.


##State of sea)##

Slight becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather)##

Rain at times, particularly later.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 9°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
